## About

This document depicts a diagram that students may use to study core anatomical terms.

## Diagrams

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-nervous-system
%%| fig-cap: "Nervous System"
flowchart TD
  A@{shape: rect, label: "Nervous System" }
  B@{shape: rect, label: "Central Nervous System (CNS)" }
  C@{shape: rect, label: "Peripheral Nervous System (PNS)" }
  
  A --- B
  A --- C
```

![By Own work, CC BY 3.0, <https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?curid=10187018>](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b2/TE-Nervous_system_diagram.svg/1280px-TE-Nervous_system_diagram.svg.png)

### Central Nervous System (CNS)

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-cns
%%| fig-cap: "Central Nervous System (CNS)"
flowchart TD

  B@{ shape: rect, label: "Brain" }
  C@{ shape: rect, label: "Spinal Cord" }
  
  A --- B
  A --- C
```

### Peripheral Nervous System (PNS)

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-pns

flowchart TD

  A --- B

```


### Forebrain

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-forebrain
%%| fig-cap: "Components of the forebrain."
flowchart TD
  A[Forebrain] --- B[Cerebral Cortex]

  H --- D[Hypothalamus]
  A --- E[Basal Ganglia]
  A --- F[Amygdala]
  A --- G[Hippocampus]
```

### Cerebral cortex

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-cortex
%%| fig-cap: "Components of the cerebral cortex."
flowchart TD
  A[Cerebral Cortex] --- B[Frontal Lobe]
  A --- C[Temporal Lobe]
  A --- D[Parietal Lobe]
  A --- E[Occipital Lobe]
  A --- F[Insula]
```

### Motor Cortex

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-frontal-lobe

flowchart TD
  B@{ shape: rect, label: "Motor Cortex" }

  E@{ shape: rect, label: "Premotor Cortex (PMC)" }
  F@{ shape: rect, label: "Primary Motor Cortex (M1)" }
  G@{ shape: rect, label: "Supplementary Motor Area (SMA)" }

  B --- F
  B --- D
  B --- E
  B --- G

  click B "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motor_cortex"
  click C "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prefrontal_cortex"
  
  style B fill:#eee,stroke:#333,stroke-width:4px;
  classDef fancy fill: #f9f, stroke: #333, stroke-width: 4px;
  class F fancy
```

## Sensory pathways

### Vision

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  Y@{ shape: circle, label: "Pupil" }
  X@{ shape: circle, label: "Lens" }
  W@{ shape: rect, label: "World", img: "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c4/Globe_icon.svg/960px-Globe_icon.svg.png?20180308223847", w: 60, h: 60, constraint: on }
  Z@{ shape: circle, label: "Cornea" }
  A@{ shape: circle, label: "Retina" }
  B@{ shape: rect, label: "Lateral Geniculate Nucleus (LGN)" }
  C@{ shape: rect, label: "Primary Visual Cortex (V1)" }
  D@{ shape: rect, label: "Suprachiasmatic Nucleus (SCN)" }
%%| E@{ shape: rect, label: "Edinger-Westphal Nucleus" }
  F@{ shape: rect, label: "Pretectal Nucleus" }
%%| G@{ shape: rect, label: "Superior Colliculus (SC)"}
%%| H@{ shape: stadium, label: "Lateral Rectus" }
%%| I@{ shape: stadium, label: "Superior Rectus" }
%%| J@{ shape: stadium, label: "Inferior Rectus" }
%%| K@{ shape: stadium, label: "Medial Rectus" }
%%| L@{ shape: stadium, label: "Superior Oblique" }
%%| M@{ shape: stadium, label: "Inferior Oblique" }
  
  W wz@-->|"Light"| Z
  Z zy@-->|"Light"| Y
  Y yx@-->|"Light"| X
  X xa@-->|"Light"| A
  A ab@-->|"CN I"| B
  B bc@-->|"Optic Radiations"| C
  A ad@-->|"Retinohypothalamic Tract"| D
  A af@--> F
  C cb@--o B
%%|   E --o|"CN III (Pupillary Reflex)"| Y
%%|   E --o|"CN III (Accomodation)"| X
%%|   F --o E
%%|   E --o G
  
  ab@{ animation: fast }
  bc@{ animation: fast }
  ad@{ animation: slow }
  cb@{ animation: slow }
  wz@{ animation: fast }
  zy@{ animation: fast }
  yx@{ animation: fast }
  xa@{ animation: fast }
  af@{ animation: fast }
```
